scientific_integrity: Proof of the universal statement is given; exact finite checks are corroboration, not a substitute for proof. Originality has residual risks and is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Over the complex numbers for the face fans of the specified box-slice polytopes and all integers \(n\ge2\). Does not classify automorphisms in positive characteristic, deformations, or singularity resolutions. The full original Liu–Zhu manuscript was not materially accessible, so a prior implicit calculation remains possible. The general toric automorphism theorem is imported as standard literature.
title: Full automorphism group of the Liu–Zhu small-alpha toric Fano varieties
